objects.description: [Cleaver](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0003) has obtained and used open-source tools such as [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029), [Windows Credential Editor](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0005), and [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002).(Citation: Cylance Cleaver)
objects.description_fa: [Cleaver](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0003) ابزارهای منبع باز مانند [PsExec](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0029)، [ویرایشگر اعتبار ویندوز](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0005) را به دست آورده و استفاده کرده است، و [Mimikatz](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0002).(Citation: Cylance Cleaver)
